## Fixes

- **Busy remote port.** `agentport setup` and `pair` now check the server
  before using the tunnel port. When the default port (39123) is already in
  use, for example by an AgentClip tunnel to the same server, they pick the
  next free port automatically. A busy `--remote-port` you passed yourself
  fails with a clear message.
- **Self-healing tunnel.** When the server refuses the reverse forward
  because the port is taken, the Companion picks a free port, saves it in the
  profile, reconfigures the agents on the server and reconnects. An existing
  profile is fixed by `agentport upgrade`, which restarts the Companion.
- **Readable tunnel errors.** The log, `agentport companion status` and the
  panel show the ssh error, such as "remote port 39123 is already in use on
  the server", instead of "exit status 255".
- **No stalled reconnects.** A tunnel that never connects is stopped after 90
  seconds and retried, so the Companion no longer waits forever on a hung ssh.

## Panel

- Dark mode is easier to read: system UI font, larger text (15px, nothing
  below 12px), lighter background, visible borders and text that meets WCAG AA
  contrast. Light mode gets the same typography.
